research_notes: A practical hard cap should be expressed as a runtime budget from actual invocation start, not from first substantive unit after bootstrap.
Bootstrap/pre-arm overhead consumes invocation wall time and therefore belongs in the operational budget even if reported separately.
This makes the cap robust to varying bootstrap complexity.
Task admission should use elapsed-from-start plus estimated next unit plus reserve/margin.
That formulation directly matches the eventual P3 contract.
Current Phase A target likewise uses invocation wall time from captured start.
